title: Publishers Are Losing Google Traffic As AI Answers Replace Links - Slashdot
excerpt: alternative_right shares a report from Axios: Google has basically stopped sending people to websites (including our site) for answers and information. content_html: alternative_right shares a report from Axios: Google has basically stopped sending people to websites (including our site) for answers and information. Instead, it's using AI to answer them on its platform, in its words. Chartbeat data shared with Axios shows Google Search traffic to publishers fell 34% over the past year. That pain is regressive. Over the past two years, small publishers lost 60% of referrals from search overall, medium publishers 47%, large publishers 22%.

sentences.zh: 在过去两年中，小型出版商损失了 60% 的搜索引荐，中型出版商损失了 47%，大型出版商损失了 22%。

content_html_zh: Alternative_right 分享了 Axios 的一份报告：Google 基本上已经停止将人们发送到网站（包括我们的网站）来获取答案和信息。 相反，用它的话说，它使用人工智能在其平台上回答这些问题。 与 Axios 共享的 Chartbeat 数据显示，过去一年，出版商的 Google 搜索流量下降了 34%。 那种痛苦是倒退的。 在过去两年中，小型出版商损失了 60% 的搜索引荐，中型出版商损失了 47%，大型出版商损失了 22%。
